Purpose: Central processing platform: sensor acquisition, DSP, Edge AI inference, Bluetooth LE reporting, LED indication
Selection Notes: Development kit not yet acquired. Confirm nRF Connect SDK release with board support and verify header pinout before wiring.

Purpose: Bearing-housing vibration measurement on three axes
Selection Notes: Prefer SPI interface with FIFO, output data rate of several kHz, selectable range (e.g. +/-8 g or +/-16 g), low noise density, Zephyr in-tree driver if available.

Item: MEMS microphone (PDM) or piezoelectric contact sensor
Purpose: Acoustic channel: airborne sound or structure-borne acoustic emission near the bearing
Selection Notes: Decision between PDM MEMS microphone and piezo contact sensor is open; piezo requires a small analog front end for the SAADC and avoids speech capture.

Item: Digital temperature sensor or NTC thermistor (housing)
Purpose: Bearing-housing surface temperature
Selection Notes: Mount with good thermal contact to the housing; same type as the ambient sensor to allow offset calibration.

Item: Digital temperature sensor or NTC thermistor (ambient)
Purpose: Ambient reference temperature for temperature-above-ambient and rise-rate features
Selection Notes: Place away from motor and bearing heat; same type as housing sensor.

Purpose: Shaft rotational speed measurement (one pulse per revolution)
Selection Notes: Open-collector output may need a pull-up; optical sensor requires a high-contrast marker; Hall sensor requires a small magnet.

Purpose: Trigger target for the RPM sensor on the shaft or coupling
Selection Notes: Must be securely fixed and balanced; include one spare.

Purpose: Drives the test shaft at controlled, limited speed
Selection Notes: Low voltage for safety; speed range sufficient for the planned test matrix; quiet operation preferred to reduce acoustic contamination.

Purpose: Sets and limits motor speed; provides soft start
Selection Notes: Must allow a hard maximum-speed limit; the Bluetooth device never controls the motor.

Purpose: Carries the test bearing, imbalance disk, and RPM target
Selection Notes: Diameter matched to the chosen bearing bore; straightness checked before use.

Purpose: Connects motor to shaft; tolerates and enables controlled misalignment tests
Selection Notes: Choose a type whose misalignment tolerance is documented so test misalignment stays within limits.

Purpose: Hold the replaceable test bearings; one position instrumented
Selection Notes: Must allow quick bearing exchange and provide a flat surface for the accelerometer mount.

Purpose: Test specimens: healthy baseline bearings and pre-worn or degraded bearings
Selection Notes: Same size and type for all specimens; label each with a bearing_id for the dataset metadata.

Purpose: Applies controlled radial or axial load / increased mechanical load conditions
Selection Notes: Load must be repeatable and documented in steps; include a method to measure or at least index the setting.

Purpose: Produces controlled mechanical imbalance in steps
Selection Notes: Masses must be captive (threaded) and strictly limited; see safety plan.

Purpose: Local indication of green / yellow / orange / red condition level and device states
Selection Notes: Driven by PWM outputs; visible from outside the guard.

Purpose: Removes motor power immediately; latching mushroom-head type
Selection Notes: Wired directly in the motor power path, independent of the development kit.

Purpose: Physical guard covering all rotating parts during operation
Selection Notes: Rigid transparent material; interlocked or at minimum fastened so it cannot be removed while running; sensor cable pass-throughs without pinch points.

Purpose: Powers the motor domain and the development kit / sensors
Selection Notes: Separate supplies or well-isolated rails for motor and sensing domains; current rating with margin.

Purpose: Rigid common mounting surface for motor, supports, load device, and guard
Selection Notes: Stiff enough to avoid dominant plate resonances in the measurement band; vibration-isolating feet optional.

Purpose: Rigid mounting of accelerometer, acoustic sensor, temperature sensors, and RPM sensor
Selection Notes: Accelerometer mount must be stiff and direct (stud or adhesive); see mechanical/sensor_mounts.

Purpose: Shielded sensor cables, connectors, jumper wires, strain relief
Selection Notes: Short shielded cables for SPI/PDM/analog lines; connectors that tolerate vibration.
